textPrompt: Create a premium, visually stunning 10-slide PowerPoint presentation titled 'The Future of Space Exploration: From Earth to Mars'. Cover the history of space exploration, reusable rockets, the International Space Station, lunar exploration, Mars rovers, technologies for human missions to Mars, deep-space challenges, future missions, and a powerful conclusion. Use scientifically accurate content and compelling visual storytelling. Incorporate high-quality, topic-relevant imagery of spacecraft, astronauts, rocket launches, lunar landscapes, Mars, and futuristic space technologies. Where AI image generation is available, generate original conceptual illustrations and embed them into the PPTX. Aim for meaningful imagery on at least 7 slides where appropriate. Use cinematic dark backgrounds, elegant typography, strong contrast, and diverse slide compositions including full-bleed imagery, split-screen layouts, timelines, comparisons, and diagrams. Avoid repetitive templates, empty slides, unreadable text, and generic decorative shapes. Ensure all images remain visible in the PPTX, PDF, and PNG previews.
